The '''1953 German football championship''' was the culmination of the [[Association football|football]] season in the [[West Germany]] in [[1952–53 Oberliga|1952–53]]. [[1. FC Kaiserslautern]] were crowned champions for the second time after a group stage and a final, having previously won the championship in [[1951 German football championship|1951]].<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duitchamp.html (West) Germany -List of champions] rsssf.org, accessed: 21 December 2015</ref><ref>[http://www.weltfussball.de/teams/1-fc-kaiserslautern/1/ 1. FC Kaiserslautern » Steckbrief] {{in lang|de}} Weltfussball.de – 1. FC Kaiserslautern honours, accessed: 21 December 2015</ref>
